member.name: M:MOM.CC.QualityStatistics.API.Controllers.StatisticController.CalculateVariableStatistics(MOM.CC.Quality.Public.Model.CalculateVariableStatisticsRequest)
member.summary: This endpoint calculates the input data and returns the response object. Depending on specification and configuration it calculates the subgroups, statistic values, and process violations. Only required properties which have no default will end with an error message. In this case, no calculation is performed. Defaults set by the component typically return warnings.
member.param: Parameter for CalulateVariableStatistics method. It summarizes all measurement data, optional historical data and configuration/specification data of a control chart for a variable characteristic. The content is used for input of CalulateVariableStatistics.

member.summary: This endpoint calculates the input of a list with several data series and returns the response object. Depending on specification and configuration it calculates the subgroups, statistic values, and process violations for each seperate data block in the series. member.param: Parameter for CalulateVariableStatistics method. It summarizes all measurement data, optional historical data and configuration/specification data of a control chart for a variable characteristic. The content is used for input of CalulateVariableStatistics.
